Start date: 1887-08-16  
Subtract 32 weeks = 32 × 7 = 224 days.  
Add 5 more days to subtract → total 229 days earlier.  

1887 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but by 100 and not by 400 → not leap).  
Days back from 1887-08-16:  
August: back 15 days to 1887-08-01 → 229 - 15 = 214 left.  
July (31 days): 214 - 31 = 183 left.  
June (30): 183 - 30 = 153 left.  
May (31): 153 - 31 = 122 left.  
April (30): 122 - 30 = 92 left.  
March (31): 92 - 31 = 61 left.  
February (28): 61 - 28 = 33 left.  
January (31): 33 - 31 = 2 left.  

Go into December 1886: December has 31 days, so 31 - 2 = 29th day of December.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1886-12-29
